test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: JROK is related to HPMI in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, GOLH is related to EMJF. To which of the given options is DLIE related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The pattern followed here is that each letter of the first term is shifted backward by 2 positions. The pattern can be summarized as **(-2, -2, -2, -2)**.

**
**For: JROK : HPMI**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee80726d557fad294294cc79d01e950740e7976e1bcbad619e20f9552a378d14.png] 

For**: GOLH : EMJF**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c09c74a80aef464ea2046b56bf3d10c3b9ce032c1c146cf4fdd56e93c6e26254.png] 

**Applying the same logic to DLIE:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4d35a1c97f1f46ae6d14ec9a35003264da224a337f1cd1f06a668311232f556.png] 

Thus, DLIE is related to BJGC.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"**.
